violations.message: Component owns an application state machine ("useMachine").
violations.why: Components are presentation-only (props plus local UI state); a state machine is application flow, which belongs in a workflow bound by a controller or hook.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the machine into features/<feature>/workflows/ and pass its state and send-handlers to the component as props.

violations.message: Component imports a controller.
violations.why: Components are reusable presentation and must not depend on the composition layer.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to props or component.

violations.message: Component imports application logic.
violations.why: Components are reusable presentation and local UI state only.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to props or component.

violations.message: Component contains inline conditional logic in its JSX.
violations.why: Conditional/loop rendering is control flow, not presentation — extract it into a named @expression unit so it stays visible, testable and reusable on its own.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to @expression (defineExpression).

violations.message: Component's JSX is too complex (nesting depth 7, 0 inline conditional/loop branches; budget is depth 6, 3 branches).
violations.why: A component-level complexity budget, separate from any one Expression's own cap, keeps a single component from growing into an unreviewable JSX tree.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to smaller, composed components and/or @expression units.

violations.message: Domain code uses an external effect.
violations.why: Domain is pure by default.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to pure function.

violations.message: Page holds its own state or effect ("useState").
violations.why: Pages are presentation-only: they compose components. State and effects belong in a hook, controller or workflow (a component may hold local UI state, a page may not).
violations.suggestedFix: Move the state/effect into a hook (features/<feature>/hooks/use<Name>State.ts, built through useTrackedState) or the controller, and pass the result down as props.

violations.message: Page imports a forbidden application layer.
violations.why: Pages are presentation-only.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to component or types.

violations.message: Page imports a forbidden application layer.
violations.why: Pages are presentation-only.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to component or types.

violations.message: Page calls fetch().
violations.why: Pages cannot own application flow.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to controller or workflow.

violations.message: Page imports a forbidden application layer.
violations.why: Pages are presentation-only.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to component or types.

violations.message: Page uses workflow/application state.
violations.why: Pages cannot own application flow.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to controller or workflow.

violations.message: Domain code calls Date.now(), so the same arguments can give a different result.
violations.why: Domain functions should be deterministic: a clock, a random number or a generated id is an input, not something to reach for, so the function stays testable and replayable.
violations.suggestedFix: Take the value as a parameter (now: number, id: string, rand: () => number) and let the caller supply it.

violations.message: Route does not import a controller.
violations.why: Routes are navigation entry points and must delegate.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to controller.

violations.message: Route contains application logic or effects.
violations.why: Routes must remain thin.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to controller.

violations.message: Service imports React/UI.
violations.why: Services own external effects, not rendering.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to api or domain or types.

violations.message: Workflow imports React/UI.
violations.why: Workflow logic must be UI-independent.
violations.suggestedFix: Move the responsibility to service or domain or types.
